From general industry practice, '40 Act ETFs often disclose a fixed creation/redemption fee plus a variable fee, which is charged to offset the cost of trading the basket. Variable fees are commonly stated as a percentage of the transaction value, and SAIs frequently cap them at around 1% to 3%. The exact cap varies by fund, so the figure should come from the filing itself.
